title: Keyless secrecy against bounded adversaries
summary: We introduce a keyless coding/cryptographic primitive that asks for two guarantees at once: the receiver is never fooled into accepting a message other than the one sent, and the adversary learns nothing about the message unless the receiver aborts. Neither the sender nor the receiver holds a secret key, and no computational hardness is assumed.
